usage_patterns.title: Batch the read-only scouting
usage_patterns.suggestion: Dispatch one scout before editing unfamiliar modules.
usage_patterns.detail: Three sessions re-read the same five files across separate turns before the first edit.
usage_patterns.copyable_prompt: Scout src/render for every call site of generateHTML before editing.

stop_doing.what: Re-reading the same file after every edit to confirm it worked
stop_doing.why: Doubled tool calls on 4 sessions with no behavior change.
stop_doing.alternative: Trust the edit response and verify once at the end.

stop_doing.what: Running the full suite after every single-line change
stop_doing.alternative: Run the single changed test file, full suite once at the end.

on_the_horizon.intro: Autonomous multi-file refactors are close to reliable for this codebase.

opportunities.title: Autonomous dependency bump
opportunities.whats_possible: A subagent updates the dependency, fixes the breaking call sites, and runs the suite unattended.
opportunities.how_to_try: Dispatch a subagent with the changelog diff as context.
opportunities.copyable_prompt: Upgrade acme-sdk to 4.x, fix all breaking call sites, run the suite.
